summary: Alterity Therapeutics filed a Form 6-K disclosing receipt of positive FDA feedback from a Type C meeting on CMC elements for its ATH434 Phase 3 program in Multiple System Atrophy. The filing reports alignment on chemistry, manufacturing, and controls, supporting readiness for Phase 3 initiation with manufacturing scale-up. No deal terms, stakeholder changes, or structural events are present. The FDA End-of-Phase 2 meeting remains on track for mid-2026. This is a routine regulatory update, not a special situation. The filing contains no acquisition, divestiture, activist, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or management change event.
